Count every preprocessing and advice-construction step in total time. Do not rank bounds for different radii as a common numerical leaderboard. Keep supplied-basis, unbounded-preprocessing query and polynomial-advice models separate.

rules: For each fixed 1 < p < ∞ return a closest vector in an arbitrary full-rank rational n-dimensional lattice under ℓp distance. The target lies in the span of the lattice. Count arithmetic operations; keep the polynomial factor in s and the coefficient bit length explicit. This is a polyhedral-norm guarantee, not a result for an arbitrary oracle norm.

regime: Exact Euclidean CVP with polynomial workspace
description: Exact Euclidean CVP with polynomial workspace

Constructing the compact basis is preprocessing and is excluded; the existence of a compact basis does not imply an efficient preprocessing algorithm. Keep c explicit and do not infer a numeric exponent from asymptotic notation.
